note: CheerpX images are build artifacts, not committed sources. Build one with: sh images/cheerpx/build-ext2.sh. Sizes are the apparent ext2 size; the file is sparse. sha256 is not reproducible across builds because mke2fs embeds a random filesystem UUID, so it identifies one published artifact rather than a function of the inputs.

debian-dev.name: Debian dev
debian-dev.description: Debian bookworm (i386) with bash, GNU coreutils, git, jq, make, python3, plus the v86 dev stack (qjs, esbuild, vmbro-httpd), the vmbro guest bridge, and vmzot (zot coding agent; needs a TCP stack, so it reports why it cannot run here).

build.packages: git jq make patch less nano procps xz-utils ca-certificates file diffutils python3 netcat-openbsd
build.note: Packages are unpacked from .deb archives without apt, so maintainer scripts never run. Smoke-test every addition on a FRESH boot with stdin closed: one hung process poisons everything queued behind it. Known bad: ripgrep hangs. Verified working: python3, qjs, esbuild, vmbro-httpd, git, jq, make.
build.devStack: qjs (extracted from the v86 dev image, musl-linked), esbuild, vmbro-httpd, dev-template project
